title: X Algo and Professional Influencer Analysis
subtitle: Mar 2 to Mar 15, 2026 · 16 posts · 1,933 views · 14 profile visits · 2 follows

intro.v: modelled on the open sourced For You pipeline: 26 predicted actions per post, a weighted sum, then author diversity decay at 0.5 to a 0.25 floor, an out of network discount of 0.75, and a cold start boost gated on originals from authors at or below 1,000 followers.
published growth write ups and analytics benchmark tiers by follower band. Every external number is linked to its source.

folBase: Account overview: 2 new follows against 5 unfollows.

footnotes.v: Follow rate = follows / views. Profile visit rate = visits / views. Engagement rate = (likes + replies + reposts + bookmarks) / views. On X views and impressions are the same number, so there is no funnel to decompose.
Piecewise linear against external lines. 0 to fair maps to 0 through 40, fair to good 40 through 70, good to excellent 70 through 100 capped.
Neither export carries a follower series. The curve is anchored on the live profile count and walked back on daily net. Totals exact, single day timing approximate.
8 of 16 posts came in under 100 views and every ratio on those rows is unreliable.
Post level views 1,933 vs account level 2,236. The gap is traffic on posts published before the window.

Weights quoted come from home-mixer/params/param.rs in the open source release, whose header records a last sync of 2026-08-12. The repository states that each weight multiplies a predicted probability, not a raw engagement count, so the ratios are not count equivalences.
Demonstration data, generated for this example. Not a real account.
Synthetic demonstration files, no folder scan and no API read. Post types were inferred from text, not confirmed against the API.
